priorityList: Use Power Siphon if you have 1 or fewer stacks of Demonic Core.
Cast Grimoire: Fel Ravager, Grimoire: Imp Lord, or Summon Doomguard on cooldown.
Summon Demonic Tyrant on cooldown, ideally alongside other major offensive buffs.
Use Implosion if you have 6 or more Wild Imps active.
Cast Hand of Gul'dan if the Dominion of Argus buff is active.
Cast Hand of Gul'dan whenever you have 3 or more Soul Shards.
Use Infernal Bolt to generate Soul Shards if you have fewer than 3.
Use Demonbolt to apply Doom to targets that do not have the debuff, provided you have a Demonic Core proc and fewer than 4 Soul Shards.
Use Demonbolt with Demonic Core procs if you have fewer than 4 Soul Shards.
Cast Shadow Bolt as your primary filler to generate Soul Shards.
Use offensive trinkets and racial abilities (like Berserking or Blood Fury) when Demonic Tyrant is active.
Use a combat potion when Demonic Tyrant is active.
